title: SentinelOps validation report
description: Schema for infrastructure/docker/scripts/run-validation.sh's report.json output. Every field is populated from a real command's actual result — never a precomputed or assumed value.

runId.description: Unique identifier for this run, e.g. validation-20260101T000000Z.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp the report was written.

commit.description: Short git commit SHA the run was executed against (or 'unknown' outside a git checkout).

workingTreeDirty.description: True if uncommitted changes were present at run time.

label.const: local benchmark/validation run — not a production claim
